    var configSysId = current.getUniqueValue();
    var tableName = current.getTableName();
    if (gs.nil(configSysId)) {
        gs.addErrorMessage("Unable to determine PCE Configuration.");
        action.setRedirectURL(tableName + '.do?sys_id=' + configSysId);
        return;
    }

    var utils = new IllumioUtils();
    var syncFilterResult = utils.getEligibleWorkloadSysIdsByConfig(configSysId, 'inclusion');

    if (!syncFilterResult.hasFilter) {
        gs.addInfoMessage("No active inclusion sync filters configured for this PCE Configuration. All conflicting workloads are eligible for sync.");
        action.setRedirectURL(tableName + '.do?sys_id=' + configSysId);
        return;
    }

    var sysIds = syncFilterResult.sysIds;

    if (!sysIds || sysIds.length === 0) {
        gs.addInfoMessage("No workloads match the active inclusion sync filter criteria.");
        action.setRedirectURL(tableName + '.do?sys_id=' + configSysId);
        return;
    }

    var REDIRECT_LIMIT = 1000;
    if (sysIds.length <= REDIRECT_LIMIT) {
        action.setRedirectURL("x_illu2_illumio_illumio_pce_workload_list.do?sysparm_query=sys_idIN" + sysIds.join(","));
    } else {
        gs.addInfoMessage(sysIds.length + " workloads match the active inclusion sync filters. Use 'Export Matching Workloads' to download the full list.");
        action.setRedirectURL(tableName + '.do?sys_id=' + configSysId);
    }
})(current, action, gs);
]]></script><show_form_icon_only>false</show_form_icon_only><show_insert>true</show_insert><show_list_icon_only>false</show_list_icon_only><show_multiple_update>false</show_multiple_update><show_query>false</show_query><show_update>true</show_update><sys_class_name>sys_ui_action</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-27 05:54:00</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>c4e09b4ec31a031050bffa0ed4013111</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Show Matching Workloads (Config)</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Illumio" source="x_illu2_illumio">15314f1ddb882700dc9fabc5ca961943</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Illumio">15314f1ddb882700dc9fabc5ca961943</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_action_c4e09b4ec31a031050bffa0ed4013111</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-27 05:54:00</sys_updated_on><table/><ui11_compatible>true</ui11_compatible><ui16_compatible>false</ui16_compatible></sys_ui_action></record_update>
